_comment: The two typefaces web/tokens/src/tokens.ts declares, pinned by tag and SHA-256.
Same discipline as cef.lock: the binaries are gitignored, this file is the pin, and
tools/fetch-fonts.ps1 reproduces the tree. tokens.ts says an external font request is
a hard failure -- av-gui runs inside a Rust-hosted webview with no network egress -- so
these are embedded at build time and never fetched at run time.
Only the weights the stylesheet actually uses. Inter is a variable font and covers its
whole range in one file; JetBrains Mono is not, and only Regular and Medium are asked
for (Medium is the 0.08em-tracked uppercase micro-label that is the visual identity).
